sources.excerpt: Overdrive Tube Tube overdrive running a 12AX7 at 200V. Baxandall EQ for warm, authentic high-voltage tube breakup. The Straight 6 Drive features a 12AX7 vacuum tube operating at 200V through Vox's Hi-Volt technology—even when battery powered. All-analog discrete circuitry with no integrated circuits delivers authentic British-voiced overdrive. Volume, Bass, Tone, Gain controls with Bright switch for sparkling highs. The passive Baxandall-style EQ provides musical tone shaping. The trans-amp circuit design ensures responsive gain stages from subtle breakup to full crunch. The slow-start heater circuit extends tube life. Rugged aluminum die-cast body with standby/on switch like a proper valve amp. True bypass switching. Powers from 6 AA batteries or DC 9V. Wide dynamic range for all playing styles.
